program:
app "Milk shop" milk ocean
table customer name text, rate money "Rate per litre"
table delivery customer ref customer, litres num 0..
table payment customer ref customer, amount money
state m date = today
monthnav m
count(customer) "customers," sum(delivery today, it.litres) "litres delivered today" head
each customer as c
  let bill = sum(c.delivery month of m, it.litres) * c.rate

      c.name bold grow

    "Paid" sum(c.payment.amount month of m) ", left" bill - sum(c.payment.amount month of m) faint
    row gap 1
      each [0.5, 1, 2] as v

form customer, "Add customer"
form payment, "Payment received"
list delivery month of m by day

app "Club accounts Buddy" users slate
table member name text
table fee member ref member, amount money
table expense what text, amount money, category pick Rent|Events|Supplies|Utilities|Other = Other
let income = sum(fee.amount)
let spent = sum(expense.amount)
screen sheet "Balance" chart
  stat income, "fees received"
  stat spent, "expenses"
  "Balance" income - spent big color if(income < spent, bad, good)
  "This month: in" sum(fee.amount month) ", out" sum(expense.amount month) faint
  each member sort name as m
    row card
      m.name grow
      sum(m.fee.amount year) "this year"
screen entry "Add" plus

  form expense, "Add expense"
  form member, "Add member"
screen yearly "Year" calendar
  "Yearly summary" head
  share expense year by category, sum(it.amount), it.key
  stat sum(fee.amount year), "fees this year"
  stat sum(expense.amount year), "expenses this year"
  "Net for the year" sum(fee.amount year) - sum(expense.amount year) big
  daybars last 7 days, sum(fee.amount on it) - sum(expense.amount on it)

  - text: "This month: in", the total amount of fee this month, ", out", the total amount of expense this month.

app "Flashcards" cards ink
table flash word text, meaning text
state i num = 0
state flipped bool = no
each flash sort at as c
  if index = i
    stack card gap 2 pad 4 align center tap set flipped = not flipped
      if flipped
        c.meaning big
      else
        c.word big
      "Tap to flip" faint
row gap 1
  button "Previous" tap set i = clamp(i - 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
  button "Next" tap set i = clamp(i + 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
i + 1 "of" count(flash) faint
form flash, "Add card"
describe:
Flashcards, in the ink colours.

- flash: word: text; meaning: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: i, starting at 0; flipped, starting at no.

        - text: the meaning of the flash.
      - otherwise:
        - text: the word of the flash.
      - text: "Tap to flip".
- a button "Previous"; a tap sets i to i minus 1 kept between 0 and how many flash entries minus 1, then sets flipped to no.
- a button "Next"; a tap sets i to i plus 1 kept between 0 and how many flash entries minus 1, then sets flipped to no.

program:
app "Household" home mint
table expense what text, amount money, category pick Rent|Groceries|School|Transport|Medicine|Eid_savings, note text?
setting lim_rent money = 45000 "Rent limit"
setting lim_groceries money = 20000 "Groceries limit"
setting lim_school money = 10000 "School limit"
setting lim_transport money = 5000 "Transport limit"
setting lim_medicine money = 3000 "Medicine limit"
setting lim_eid money = 5000 "Eid savings limit"
state m date = today
monthnav m
"Spent this month" sum(expense.amount month of m) big
each options expense.category as k
  let spent = sum(expense.amount month of m where category = k)
  let lim = if(k = Rent, lim_rent, if(k = Groceries, lim_groceries, if(k = School, lim_school, if(k = Transport, lim_transport, if(k = Medicine, lim_medicine, lim_eid)))))
  stack gap 1
    row
      k bold grow color if(spent > lim, bad, ink)
      spent "of" lim
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / lim, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > lim, bad, accent) radius 2
form expense
list expense month of m by day
describe:
Household, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- expense: what: text; amount: money; category: one of Rent, Groceries, School, Transport, Medicine, Eid savings; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.

- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: "Spent this month", the total amount of expense in the month of m.
- for each choice of the category of the expense:
  - text: the choice.
  - text: spent, "of", lim.
  - a drawing made of rectangles.
- a form to add a expense.
